description: This Swift source file defines a SwiftUI View named ConfigSettings, which manages the display and interaction for configuration settings in a schema-driven form interface. It includes nested structs and private methods to handle sections, subsections, and schema resolution, along with UI components for sidebar and detail views.

classes.name: ConfigSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI View for managing and displaying configuration settings based on a schema, including handling sections, subsections, and schema resolution.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Constructs the main view layout, including sidebar and detailed view, and manages initial loading tasks.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures a valid section and subsection are selected based on current schema and state.

methods.name: resolveSections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts configuration sections from a schema node.

methods.name: resolveSubsections
methods.description: Resolves and sorts subsections within a configuration section.

methods.name: resolvedSchemaNode
methods.description: Resolves the effective schema node from a potentially composite schema.

methods.name: humanize
methods.description: Converts a key string into a human-readable label.

methods.name: selectSection
methods.description: Handles user selection of a configuration section, updating active states.

methods.name: ensureSubsection
methods.description: Ensures an appropriate subsection is selected for a given section.
